newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia truckers end blockade of Hungary border.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia truckers end blockade of Hungary border.

text.p: Slovenian truck drivers ended a 24-hour blockade of a key border crossing between Slovenia and Hungary early on Friday after reaching an agreement with the government aimed at speeding up administrative procedures.

"The government's negotiating group agreed to contact the Hungarian government in 14 days to try to speed up custom administration procedures on the Hungarian side," Slavko Horvat, head of the local custom office and a member of the government's negotiating team, told Reuters.
He said about 70 trucks had blocked the Dolga Vas border crossing on Thursday to protest against slow administration on the Hungarian side, which had caused average waiting times of about 15 hours.
The station, about 210 km (130 miles) east of Ljubljana, is the only freight crossing between the two countries and is used by an average of some 950 trucks a day.
Horvat said the government also promised it would try to reach an agreement with Hungary to divert all passenger car traffic to a smaller crossing, Pince, some 10 km south of Dolga Vas.
